title: Abstract task output row
description: One abstract's key facts: what the study is, and its one or two main findings (none when the abstract reports no results). Each fact is in the model's own words, one claim, at most 250 characters; the quote is optional evidence, verbatim from the abstract, and not scored.

fact.description: one claim, in the model's own words

quote.description: optional: verbatim from the abstract, supporting the fact

about.description: what kind of study, on what system, to what end

findings.description: the main results, most important first; empty only when the abstract reports none
